Thanks for contributing to DisposableEmail! Please fill in the checklist below.
For substantial changes, please open an issue first to discuss the approach.
-->

## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change, and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behaviour)
- [ ] Bundled list update (adding/removing domains in `disposable_domains.json`)
- [ ] Documentation only

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests have been added or updated for behavioural changes.
- [ ] `composer qa` passes (PHP-CS-Fixer, PHPStan level 10, PHPUnit).
- [ ] The `CHANGELOG.md` "Unreleased" section has been updated (if user-facing).
- [ ] List entries (if any) are lowercase, at the eTLD+1 level, and sorted.
